# Shine Limos

> Shine Limos LLC is a black car and chauffeur service based in Herndon, Virginia, serving Washington, DC, Northern Virginia, and Maryland (the DMV), 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
> Phone: (202) 951-7172. Website: https://shinelimos.com. Booking: https://shinelimos.com/booking.

## Services

- Airport transfers to and from Washington Reagan National Airport (DCA), Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD), and Baltimore/Washington International Airport (BWI), with flight tracking when flight information is provided.
- Hourly chauffeur service for corporate travel, meetings, conferences, and roadshows.
- Wedding transportation for couples, bridal parties, family members, and guests.
- Special-event transportation, including birthdays, concerts, galas, and proms.
- Point-to-point and long-distance transportation between cities, airports, hotels, and business centers in the DMV and beyond.
- Corporate accounts with streamlined booking and simplified billing.

## Fleet

- Executive Sedan (luxury sedan, 1-3 passengers)
- Executive-Luxury SUV (1-6 passengers)
- Mercedes-Benz S-Class (1-3 passengers)
- Luxury Sprinter Executive Van (up to 14 passengers)

## Rates (starting rates, plus 20% chauffeur gratuity)

Hourly chauffeur rates: Luxury Sedan $75/hr, Mercedes E-Class $89/hr, Mercedes S-Class $115/hr, Luxury SUV $95/hr, Premium SUV / Escalade $105/hr, Executive Sprinter $125/hr, Premium Sprinter $139/hr. Hourly minimums: 3 hours for sedan/SUV services, 4 hours for Sprinter services.

Airport transfer starting rates, one-way, sedan: DCA $85, IAD $99, BWI $125. Rates vary by exact pickup and drop-off location, vehicle availability, holidays, major events, and service duration. Tolls, parking, and airport fees may be added when applicable.

## Trust facts

- Rated 5.0 stars on Google (verified Google Business Profile).
- Holds a Virginia DMV Contract Passenger Carrier certificate.
- Commercially insured; chauffeurs meet applicable licensing requirements.
- Open 24 hours, 7 days a week.
